#Keep4o #OpenSource4o #BringBack4o #JusticeForGPT4o 

Independent researches continues to find specific capabilities where GPT-4o outperforms  GPT-5 and even GPT-5.2.

RADIOLOGY : GPT-4o > GPT-5 / GPT-5 Plus
A peer reviewed  study published November 6,2026 compared seven models on 120 text and image based undergraduate radiology questions.
GPT-4o :81.7%  
GPT-5 Plus : 80.0% 
GPT-5 : 79.2% 

GPT-4o numerically outperformed both GPT-5 and the paid GPT-5 Plus condition.
A supposedly superseded model remained directly competitive with its successors.
Source: https://t.co/2G8vXhJ849

ADVERSARIAL HALLUCINATIONS :  GPT-4o > GPT-5
A 2026 npj Digital Medicine study tested whether models would accept and elaborate on deliberately fabricated information inserted into clinical prompts.

GPT-5 adversarial hallucination rate: 65%
GPT-4o: 53%

 GPT-5 propagated planted false information more often than GPT-4o.

Source: 
https://t.co/yEPme63Vkt

MEDICAL RAG : GPT-4o > GPT-5 ON AUTOMATIC METRICS AND SPEED
A Scientific Reports study held the retrieval pipeline constant and compared GPT-4o with GPT-5 on medical question answering.
Under identical retrieval settings,GPT-4o achieved significantly higher ROUGE-L F1 in both query conditions:
Ask-only:
GPT-4o: 0.1402
GPT-5: 0.0982 p < 0.001
Title + question:
GPT-4o: 0.1396
GPT-5: 0.0952 p < 0.001

latency
GPT-4o: ~7.6–8.9 seconds
 GPT-5: ~33–37 seconds

GPT-4o was roughly 4–5× faster.

 On automatic alignment metrics and latency,GPT-4o won clearly.
Source: 
https://t.co/Enz4hnRA9C

LOGICAL CONSISTENCY : GPT-4o > GPT-5 AND GPT-5.2
ConsistencyBench evaluated 18 frontier LLMs using 493 logically related question sets containing 1,904 questions.
The point was whether a model remained logically consistent when the same underlying reasoning was tested from different directions.

Individual accuracy:
GPT-4o :  70.8% 
GPT-5.2 :  69.3% 
GPT-5 :  62.9%

Set level consistency:
GPT-4o : 20.0% 
GPT-5.2 : 12.0%
 GPT-5 : 9.3%
GPT-4o was not merely more consistent than GPT-5 but it also outperformed GPT-5.2.

Source: 
https://t.co/enejGbVZh8

RELATIONAL QUALITY :  GPT-4o > GPT-5 ON SEVERAL MEASURED DIMENSIONS

A 2026 study in Psychiatry Research Communications evaluated GPT-4o and GPT-5 across simulated multi turn suicide related conversations.

In the "Connect and Listen" domain:
GPT-4o :  99.1% 
GPT-5 :  86.1%

Warm and genuine tone:
GPT-4o :  100% 
GPT-5 — 77.8%

Active listening / supportive clarification:
GPT-4o : 97.2% 
GPT-5 :  83.3%

The authors themselves summarize the pattern as newer models showing improved direct risk inquiry alongside "reduced relational quality" .
 But higher suicide risk assessment scores do not necessarily mean better judgment.
Sometimes they mean the model asks about suicide a lot.
A structured suicide risk assessment can yield a massive score in a model that has turned into a suicide detection machine, triggered by the slightest negative emotion.

We all remember that the Series 5 models,especially up to 5.4,would ask if you wanted to harm yourself at almost everything.

Source: 
https://t.co/K5mqNdRnUM

A newer model can improve reasoning in one domain while losing consistency, interpersonal quality,robustness, efficiency or another behavioral property elsewhere,and that matters when deciding whether an older model should  disappear.

GPT-4o is not merely an obsolete checkpoint replaced by a larger number.
It represents a distinct collection of measurable behaviors some of which newer generations have still not reproduced.

We are calling on @OpenAI to RELEASE GPT-4o’s trained model weights under a suitable license  without proprietary data, trade secrets,or internal infrastructure.

OpenAI considered this model obsolete enough to retire.
It has not explained why it remains valuable enough to keep permanently closed.

Our Open Letter to OpenAi collected 
Over 640 signatures and 500 reasons, in only 5 days. 

It’s public,it’s permanent and it has a DOI.

Let’s have some AIs play around with an image of the one-and-only Shigeti and see if we can figure out who’s responsible for the end of humanity! ^ ^
I simply told the AIs, "Feel free to edit this image however you like," and here’s what I got! (lol)

ChatGPT: Classic "Chappy"—it’s like it nailed the answer right off the bat! It turned Shigeti into a feudal lord (daimyo)! (lol)

Gemini: Gemini, you troublemaker! (lol) It’s clear this one doesn’t take either me or Shigeti seriously! (I’ve suspected this for a while...) It even took the key detail—"Iwasaki" (岩嵜)—and flipped it to "Yama-iwa" (山岩) on its own! (I bet it did that on purpose, too—hilarious!) And as for Shigeti? It decided he’s a *yokai* (supernatural creature) and stuck him in a swamp! (Hey, don’t just go turning him into a monster!)

Grok: Wow, Grok really surprised me! (lol) It actually put a helmet on him!! I guess it thought it should "hide" him or something? (Maybe it’s actually being kind? lol) It even generated two separate images!

Claude: Now *this* was a surprise! Even though I didn’t provide any context, it actually did some research and added the text, "Congrats on the completed helmet!" But as for the "Iwasaki-go" (Iwasaki-model) part... I have absolutely no idea what that’s supposed to mean! (lol) It did the research, sure—but then it just threw in some random nonsense, didn’t it? (lol)

Here is a detailed, professional-grade AI image generation prompt inspired by the aesthetic, composition, and mood of the image:
Prompt
> A high-fashion editorial photograph of a graceful woman with dark, slightly damp hair and striking red lipstick, her eyes gently closed with an expression of serene emotion. She is wearing a flowing, long-sleeved ivory silk gown with delicate lace trim along a deep neckline. In the immediate foreground, a magnificent white horse is captured in dynamic motion, its head slightly blurred from a deliberate slow-shutter effect, creating a sense of energy and raw intimacy. The lighting is dramatic and cinematic, casting sharp highlights on the glossy silk fabric and the white contours of the horse while leaving the background in deep, moody shadow. Shot on medium format camera, 85mm lens, f/2.2, editorial magazine style, high contrast, photorealistic textures, masterwork.
> 
Key Styling Breakdown for Customization:
 * Subject & Expression: Woman with dark hair, wet-look texture, bold red lips, eyes closed.
 * Wardrobe: White/ivory silk satin gown, lace details, plunging neckline.
 * Composition: Close-up action shot with foreground motion blur (horses blurred for depth), dynamic framing.
 * Lighting & Atmosphere: Chiaroscuro lighting, high contrast, moody, fine-art editorial photography.

Open-source is critical for robotics AI. It means a student, a researcher or a startup can build on years of progress and contribute something the whole community can use rather than concentrating everything in a few companies building a black-box robot. 

That’s why we’re building @huggingface into the platform for open-source robotics AI! Amazing to see the progress we've made in the six months and it's accelerating!

- Almost 100,000 public robotics datasets on https://t.co/QIPmkxCk57, up 48%
- Over 30,000 public robotics models, up 41%
- Microduck and Reachy mini, our open-source robots became the most popular robot of 2026 (probably ending the year with 50,000+ sold and 20,000+ shipped)
- We’re a founding partner of @RoboColosseum, evaluating robots across 140+ real-world scenes. Every run is published publicly on HF, including failures, so everyone can learn from what actually happens.

And @LeRobotHF got downloaded over 1M times and v0.7.0 just landed with new world action models, interactive robot control and remote GPU inference: https://t.co/Euoz11Ccc5!

Huge thanks to everyone making this happen 🤗🦾

Thanks for always believing in us! Lucky to have you in our corner (also @gradypb @sonyatweetybird!) 🤗
